prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Recipe box". When I paste a recipe, clean it up: a title, servings and time on one line, the ingredients as a checklist, staples the steps use (oil, salt) on a "From the cupboard" line, and short numbered steps, without the life story. Save it as a sub-note with create, in the folder named after the note ("Recipe box/<recipe title>.md", beside it), then read the note with fetch and move its link line under "Weeknight", "Weekend" or "Baking" with edit, whichever fits. Recipes I want to try later go under "Want to try" as a bullet. When I ask what to cook, look through the box with search.

asks: Ask me for the recipe I want to save, then add it with its ingredients and steps.
What can I make with chickpeas and spinach?
Halve the lentil soup for two.

args.content:
Lentil soup with lemon

Serves 4, 35 minutes.

- [ ] 250 g red lentils
- [ ] 1 onion
- [ ] 2 carrots
- [ ] 2 cloves of garlic
- [ ] 1 tsp ground cumin
- [ ] 2 lemons

From the cupboard: olive oil, salt.

1. Soften the onion, carrots and garlic in olive oil with the cumin.
2. Add the lentils and a litre of water. Simmer for 20 minutes.
3. Blend half of it, then stir in the lemon juice and salt to taste.
